Subject: Compliance bundle + PO flow for Aster procurement

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we had a positive stakeholder sync and procurement asked me to gather the security and billing artifacts before we open a PO. Specifically they want: 1) executed DPA (or doc we can e-sign), 2) latest SOC 2 report (or a summary + link), 3) current subprocessor inventory, and 4) a short note on how Redwood routes invoices/POs and expected payment terms so we can align with our AP team.

Can you send the materials or point me to a secure link? Also let me know if Redwood needs an initial PO placeholder (we typically send a 12-month estimate) or if you require an SOW.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement has a tight cadence this quarter.

Thanks,
Maya Reddy
Head of IT Procurement
Aster Labs

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Ben (sales ops) and Laura (legal/procurement ops) to help finish this off.

Quick answers up front:
- DPA: we have a current DPA (v3) that we can send for e-signature. Im attaching the PDF; Ben will kick off DocuSign if that works.
- SOC 2: weve attached a one-page summary and provided a secure drive link to the full report (redacted where needed).
- Subprocessors: Ill attach our inventory export (CSV) and confirm whether any new additions are pending.
- PO / Invoicing: Redwood accepts PO to billing@redwood.ai. Standard net-30 on invoices; we can accept net-45 on initial enterprise orders with a short note from procurement. For reserved/dedicated contracts we typically require a signed order form and a billing contact. Ive attached a short PO-instructions PDF for AP.

If procurement needs a placeholder PO, were fine with an estimate-based PO; Ben, can you propose the placeholder language?

Next steps: Ben will share the DocuSign link for the DPA and confirm invoicing contact details. Laura — any procurement redline risks on the DPA?

Best,
Jordan

Redwood Inference

Hi Maya — Ben here (sales ops). Good to meet you virtually.

Jordan covered most items. For procurement language, we typically accept a placeholder PO with the following fields: vendor name (Redwood Inference), Redwood remit to: Redwood Inference, Inc., 4100 Redwood Ave, Suite 100, San Francisco, CA 94107, billing@redwood.ai, estimated monthly commitment (or annual not-to-exceed), and "Services subject to DPA v3" in the PO notes. Please include the procurement contact for invoice routing.

If Aster wants net-45 on the initial invoice, mark that in the PO and well honor it for the first invoice; after that we revert to net-30. For dedicated/reserved capacity, AP may require an initial 30% prepay depending on the order profile — I can surface that if you plan to request Reserved.

Ill send the DocuSign link for the DPA right after lunch and attach the current subprocessor CSV in the next email.

Thanks,

Redwood Inference, Inc. | 4100 Redwood Ave, Suite 100, San Francisco, CA 94107 | billing@redwood.ai
